description:
✦ Hey! We’re Probably Aliens 👽
We’re joining NASA Space Apps for the Planet X & SPHEREx challenge and looking for people who genuinely love space and want to build something together. No experts required! If you’re into coding, AI/ML, astronomy, data, design, or research — or just enjoy turning ideas into projects — you’ll fit right in. We’re here to learn, collaborate, experiment, and create something awesome. 🚀
